::: {.spectrum-widget .kurie-widget}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false

kurieMass = 1
kurieX = Array.from({length: 501}, (_, i) => -3 + 3 * i / 500)

kurieValue = (x, mass) => {
  const neutrinoEnergy = -x;
  if (neutrinoEnergy < mass) return null;
  return Math.sqrt(
    neutrinoEnergy
    * Math.sqrt(neutrinoEnergy * neutrinoEnergy - mass * mass)
  );
}

kurieMassless = kurieX.map(x => ({
  x,
  y: kurieValue(x, 0)
}))

kurieMassive = kurieX
  .filter(x => -x >= kurieMass)
  .map(x => ({
    x,
    y: kurieValue(x, kurieMass)
  }))

kuriePlot = Plot.plot({
  width: 1040,
  height: 310,
  marginTop: 18,
  marginRight: 25,
  marginBottom: 45,
  marginLeft: 65,
  style: {
    background: "#ffffff",
    color: "#111111",
    fontSize: "20px"
  },
  x: {
    axis: "bottom",
    label: null,
    domain: [-3, 0],
    ticks: 6,
    grid: true
  },
  y: {
    axis: "left",
    label: null,
    domain: [0, 3.1],
    ticks: 6,
    grid: true,
    tickFormat: value => value.toFixed(1)
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([0], {
      stroke: "#111111",
      strokeWidth: 1.5
    }),
    Plot.line(kurieMassless, {
      x: "x",
      y: "y",
      stroke: "#4ea1ff",
      strokeWidth: 4
    }),
    Plot.line(kurieMassive, {
      x: "x",
      y: "y",
      stroke: "#ffb347",
      strokeWidth: 4
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([-kurieMass], {
      stroke: "#ffb347",
      strokeDasharray: "7,5",
      strokeWidth: 2.5
    }),
    Plot.frame({stroke: "#111111"})
  ]
})

html`
<div class="spectrum-panel">
  <div class="spectrum-legend">
    <span>
      <i class="spectrum-swatch spectrum-swatch-massless"></i>
      ${tex`m_\beta=0`}
    </span>
    <span>
      <i class="spectrum-swatch spectrum-swatch-massive"></i>
      ${tex`m_\beta=1\ \text{эВ}`}
    </span>
  </div>
  <div class="spectrum-plot-row">
    <div class="spectrum-y-label">${tex`K(E)\;(\text{отн. ед.})`}</div>
    <div class="spectrum-plot-host">${kuriePlot}</div>
  </div>
  <div class="spectrum-x-label">${tex`E-E_0\;(\text{эВ})`}</div>
</div>`
```
:::
